snippet.title: Cozy Parkour Adventure Game | Sunny Side Up | Hatching This Summer!
snippet.description:
Welcome to Sunny Side Up - a cozy parkour adventure where every jump brings you closer to home 🐣

In this first demo, get a glimpse of the movement, level design, and the charming world you’ll explore as you roll, jump, and climb your way through handcrafted environments. With smooth controls and relaxing vibes, Sunny Side Up is all about mastering momentum while enjoying the journey.

🌼 About the Game
You play as a small egg on a heartfelt mission to find your mother hen and return to your family. Along the way, you’ll tackle creative parkour challenges across five unique levels, each designed to test your skill and timing while keeping things fun and accessible.

🎮 Coming This Summer - Wishlist Now!
Your support helps shape the game as we continue development.

👉 Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4267080/Sunny_Side_Up/

🌐 Visit our website:
https://www.playsunnysideup.com/

💬 We’d love your feedback!
Drop a comment and let us know what you think - your input helps us improve movement, level design, and overall gameplay.
